roadmap.title: Classic mode role achievements
roadmap.description: Play Classic mode games in a private lobby with helper players so you can pick or force the role you need. Get the single-event Impostor and Crewmate achievements, then the four map wins.

roadmap.title: Lobby-settings achievements
roadmap.description: Change the lobby settings for the setup-heavy unlocks: two Impostors, Shapeshifter, Guardian Angel, a short kill cooldown, and Submit Scan. Use helper players.

roadmap.title: Counter grinds and Hide n Seek
roadmap.description: Finish the long counters last: 150 Classic kills, 500 tasks, and the Hide n Seek wins and seeker kills. Use a private lobby where you choose the seeker.

achievements.description: Get your first kill
achievements.summary: Get your first kill as the Impostor in a Classic mode game.

steps.text: Play a Classic game as the Impostor and kill one Crewmate.

achievements.description: Get 5 total kills
achievements.summary: Get 5 total kills as the Impostor in Classic mode.

steps.text: Kill Crewmates as the Impostor in Classic games until your total reaches 5.

achievements.description: Get 50 total kills
achievements.summary: Get 50 total kills as the Impostor in Classic mode.

steps.text: Host a private Classic lobby with helper players and lower the @mechanic{Impostor kill cooldown} in the lobby settings.
When you are the Impostor, kill everyone as fast as you can. If you are not, vote out the Impostor and start a new game.
Repeat until your total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Get 150 total kills as the Impostor in Classic mode.
achievements.summary: Get 150 total kills as the Impostor in Classic mode.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam. Only Classic mode kills are listed as counting.

steps.text: Host a private Classic lobby with helper players and lower the @mechanic{Impostor kill cooldown} in the lobby settings.
When you are the Impostor, kill everyone as fast as you can. If you are not, vote out the Impostor and start a new game.
Repeat until your total reaches 150.

achievements.description: Complete 10 total tasks
achievements.summary: Complete 10 tasks in total.

steps.text: Finish tasks as a Crewmate until your total reaches 10.

achievements.description: Complete 100 total tasks
achievements.summary: Complete 100 tasks in total.

steps.text: Host a private lobby with helper players and set the number of tasks to the maximum in the lobby settings.
Play as a Crewmate and finish tasks. Ask helpers to leave the tasks to you.
Repeat until your total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Complete 500 tasks in total.
achievements.summary: Complete 500 tasks in total.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam. It can unlock late, so keep playing if it does not appear right away.

steps.text: Host a private lobby with helper players and set the number of tasks to the maximum in the lobby settings.
Play as a Crewmate and finish tasks. Ask helpers to leave the tasks to you.
Repeat until your total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Win 3 games on Skeld
achievements.summary: Win 3 games on the Skeld map.

steps.text: Set the map to Skeld in a private lobby. Win 3 games there as either role.

achievements.description: Win 3 games on MIRA
achievements.summary: Win three games played on the MIRA HQ map.

steps.text: Set the map to MIRA HQ in a private lobby. Win 3 games there as either role.

achievements.description: Win 3 games on Polus
achievements.summary: Win three games played on the Polus map.

steps.text: Set the map to Polus in a private lobby. Win 3 games there as either role.

achievements.description: Win 3 games on The Airship
achievements.summary: Win three games played on The Airship map.

steps.text: Set the map to The Airship in a private lobby. Win 3 games there as either role.

achievements.description: Win a game with 2 Impostors while both Impostors are still alive at the end.
achievements.summary: Win a game with 2 Impostors while both Impostors are still alive at the end.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam. You can also filter public matchmaking for 2-Impostor games and repeat until you are Impostor and win with both alive.

steps.text: Host a private lobby with 5 players and set the number of Impostors to 2 in the lobby computer.
As one Impostor, kill one Crewmate so the Impostors win with both alive.

achievements.description: Win a game by completing all tasks as a crewmate
achievements.summary: Win a game as a Crewmate by completing all tasks.

steps.text: In a private lobby, set common, long and short tasks to 0 and Task Bar Updates to Always.
Have every Crewmate finish their tasks until the task bar fills.

achievements.description: Win a game by sabotaging a critical system as Impostor.
achievements.summary: Win a game as the Impostor by letting a critical sabotage run out.

guide.context: Playing alone, kill Crewmates until only 2 or 3 remain before you start the critical sabotage.

steps.text: As the Impostor, press Tab and start the O2 sabotage.
Wait for the timer to run out without any Crewmate fixing it. Helpers can simply not fix it.

achievements.description: Win a game by killing all crewmates as Impostor.
achievements.summary: Win a game as the Impostor by killing all Crewmates.

steps.text: Play as the Impostor and kill Crewmates until none are left.

achievements.description: Survive and win a game as a crewmate
achievements.summary: Win a game as a Crewmate while you are still alive at the end.

steps.text: Play as a Crewmate, stay alive, and win by finishing tasks or voting out the Impostors.

achievements.description: Win a game by vote as Impostor
achievements.summary: Win a game as the Impostor when the winning ejection is a vote, not a kill.

steps.text: Kill one Crewmate, then report the body.
In the meeting, have everyone vote out another Crewmate so the Impostors reach the winning number.

achievements.description: Complete the Swipe Card task in Admin on your first try in a game.
achievements.summary: Complete the Swipe Card task in Admin on your first try in a game.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam. Practice mode lets you learn the speed first.

steps.text: As a Crewmate, get the Swipe Card task and go to the Admin room.
Swipe the card once at a steady speed. A swipe that is too slow or too fast counts as a failed try.

achievements.description: Get a kill during a lights sabotage
achievements.summary: Get a kill as the Impostor while the Lights sabotage is active.

steps.text: As the Impostor, press Tab and start the Lights sabotage.
Get near a Crewmate and press Kill before anyone fixes the lights.

achievements.description: Be killed while doing the Submit Scan task in MedBay.
achievements.summary: Be killed while doing the Submit Scan task in MedBay.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam. Playing alone, keep starting and cancelling the scan until the Impostor finds you.

steps.text: In a private lobby, use these settings: Visual Tasks on, Task Bar Updates Always, 2 common, 3 long and 5 short tasks.
Start the game as a Crewmate. If you do not get Submit Scan, leave and start a new game.
Go to MedBay and start the scan, then have the Impostor kill you before it ends.

achievements.description: Fix a sabotage that you started as the Impostor.
achievements.summary: Fix a sabotage that you started as the Impostor.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam.

steps.text: As the Impostor, start the Lights sabotage.
Go to the power supply and complete the Lights fix yourself.

achievements.displayName: H U N G E R
achievements.description: Get 3 kills as the Impostor before any meeting is called.
achievements.summary: Get 3 kills as the Impostor before any meeting is called.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam.

steps.text: Host a game with at least 5 players and lower the @mechanic{Impostor kill cooldown} to about 10 seconds.
As the Impostor, kill 3 Crewmates who are alone before anyone reports a body.

achievements.description: Win a game as crew with your only votes being for the Impostor
achievements.summary: Win as a Crewmate after casting votes only for the Impostor.

steps.text: Call an emergency meeting once you know who the Impostor is.
Vote for the Impostor and never vote for anyone else or skip. In a private lobby, all helpers can vote the same way.

achievements.description: Win a game as the Impostor without using a vent.
achievements.summary: Win a game as the Impostor without using a vent.

guide.context: This achievement is hidden on Steam.

steps.text: Play as the Impostor and win by kills or votes without entering any vent.

achievements.description: Survive a Game as Crew in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Survive until the end of a Hide n Seek game as a Crewmate.

steps.text: Play Hide n Seek as a hider and stay alive until the game ends.

achievements.description: Kill all hiders as impostor in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Kill all hiders as the Impostor in Hide n Seek mode.

steps.text: Play Hide n Seek as the Impostor and kill every hider. Press Q to kill, which works better than clicking.

achievements.description: Do all your tasks in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Complete all your tasks as a Crewmate in Hide n Seek mode.

steps.text: Play Hide n Seek as a Crewmate and finish every task you are given. You do not have to win or survive.

achievements.description: Kill Someone while disguised as them
achievements.summary: As a Shapeshifter Impostor, kill a Crewmate while disguised as another Crewmate.

steps.text: In the lobby settings, turn on Shapeshifter and make sure you are the Shapeshifter.
Press the Shift button in the bottom right and pick a Crewmate.
While still disguised, get near a Crewmate and kill them.

achievements.description: Block a kill as a guardian angel
achievements.summary: As a Guardian Angel, shield a Crewmate from an Impostor's kill.

guide.context: In a private lobby, a helper Impostor can kill you first and then try to kill your protected target.

steps.text: In the lobby settings, turn on Guardian Angel.
Die in a game. You become a Guardian Angel.
Use Protect on a living Crewmate, then wait for the Impostor to try to kill them. The shield blocks the kill.

achievements.description: 10 wins as a hider in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Win ten Hide n Seek games while playing a Crewmate hider.

guide.context: In a private lobby, a fast win is to have the seeker's helper leave the game.

steps.text: Host a private Hide n Seek lobby with helper players.
Win as a hider 10 times. You do not need to be alive at the end.

achievements.description: 50 wins as a hider in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Win fifty Hide n Seek games while playing a Crewmate hider.

guide.context: In a private lobby, a fast win is to have the seeker's helper leave the game.

steps.text: Host a private Hide n Seek lobby with helper players.
Win as a hider 50 times. You do not need to be alive at the end.

achievements.description: 100 kills as a seeker in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Kill 100 hiders in total while playing the seeker in Hide n Seek.

steps.text: Host a private Hide n Seek lobby and choose yourself as the Impostor in the lobby computer settings.
Kill hiders every match until your total reaches 100.

achievements.description: 200 kills as a seeker in Hide n Seek Mode
achievements.summary: Kill 200 hiders in total while playing the seeker in Hide n Seek.

steps.text: Host a private Hide n Seek lobby and choose yourself as the Impostor in the lobby computer settings.
Kill hiders every match until your total reaches 200.
